releases.notes:
## Feature Additions

- Channels can now carry items, fluids, energy, chemicals and Source at the same time. The Type row is now Resources: switch each kind on or off and give it its own batch. New channels carry everything they can; existing channels keep their old type
- Filters now hold items, fluids and chemicals together, and a whitelist only limits the kinds it lists
- Filter entries can now set a Side on their advanced page: the face of the receiving block that item, fluid or chemical goes in through, so one channel can feed a furnace ore on top and coal on the side. A side on a receiver's filter wins over the sender's
- Added ars energistique support
- Added the Recipe Card: write a recipe on it (JEI/EMI + button or by hand) with items, fluids and Mekanism chemicals, put it in any filter like any other entry, and the channel sends only whole recipe sets (every resource together) in every distribution mode, with an optional Blocking mode. The card's kinds must be switched on in Resources at both ends, and whole sets per operation are set on the Recipe sets line of the Resources popover
- Recipe Card ingredients have a pencil that opens the same advanced page as filter entries: choose the receiving side for items, fluids and chemicals, require exact NBT (the default) or set NBT rules, and list receiver slots for items with Split to share the count evenly, so machines like the vanilla Crafter get an exact layout
- Recipe Cards can copy an AE2 or Refined Storage pattern: hold an encoded pattern and click the new pattern slot to fill the card with its items, fluids and chemicals
- ComputerCraft: getChannels entries and watch samples gain `types`, and samples gain `totals` per type; `type` and `total` now describe the first type
- Added a built-in "Original Textures" resource pack that restores the pre-1.17.1 upgrade and wrench textures
- Added sounds for button click's in mod's GUIs
- Nodes with a Network Upgrade on an AE2 ME Interface that has nothing configured can now pull anything from the whole ME network. Configure the Interface to limit what they can take (thanks Qther)
- Network Upgrade now moves chemicals through the whole storage network (Applied Mekanistics on AE2, Refined Storage Mekanism Integration on RS) instead of only through the Interface's own buffer
- Removing a node with the wrench or by breaking the block it sits on now puts the node and its upgrades straight into your inventory, dropping only what doesn't fit (thanks Qther)
- Creative players no longer use up nodes when placing them with the wrench, or upgrades when pasting a wrench clipboard (thanks Qther)
- New Logistics Node look: a flat frame texture on the item, the helmet and placed nodes, with connected nodes outlined as one shape. A lone node on a full block now draws 6 quads instead of 48, and the item model no longer z-fights (#126)
- Netherite energy channels now move up to 137,438,953,408 RF per tick instead of 2,147,483,647, shared across the channel's receivers. An existing Netherite Energy Batch of exactly 2147483647 in upgrades.json is rewritten to the new maximum on load. Admins can set it higher so several receivers add up, but one sender and receiver pair stops at about 137 billion RF per tick, and so does a whole Equal Distribution channel
- Added Curios support: wear the wrench in the new Logistics Wrench slot and press K to use it as if it were in your hand, without giving up a hotbar slot

## Bug Fixes

- Logistics Nodes no longer show up as entity dots on Xaero's Minimap and World Map radar (#148)
- Nodes joining a label now get the label's latest settings instead of the ones it had when it was created (#149)
- Block icons in the graph editor no longer draw on top of the node hover tooltip
- Labeled nodes that were unloaded while the label was edited now pick up the changes when they load
- Pasting a wrench clipboard onto a node now gives it its label's current settings instead of the clipboard's

...

releases.notes:
## Feature Additions

- Added simple math (like `64*7`, `64+1`) to batch, stock, priority and delay fields
- Mod now supports Building Gadgets 2's copy paste, cut paste and schematic system
- Added distribution mode "Priority Robin": each send goes to the next receiver, cycling from highest to lowest priority
- The network picker now sorts New→Old by default. Networks from older worlds get a creation time the first time one of their nodes is opened
- Redesigned the Computer's I/O Monitor: every channel on one page with live rates, a modern bar chart (30s / 1m / 2m), and a breakdown of exactly which items and fluids are moving
- Added ComputerCraft support: a CC computer next to the Computer can read networks, channels, nodes, the node graph and live I/O telemetry. Computers placed before this update need to be broken and placed again to be used from ComputerCraft
- Regex filter can match tooltips again (Name / Tooltip / Both); tooltip text is built safely on the server so mods with client-only tooltip code no longer crash dedicated servers (#83)
- Flow line settings moved from the mod config onto the wrench (press G): every wrench has its own line colors per resource type, Routed or Direct lines, and filters for resource type, channel and network. Lines can now reach nodes that are off-screen or too far away to render. Flow line settings from the old config are not carried over
- Nodes can no longer be moved by `/tp`, `/teleport`, `/spreadplayers` or other mods' teleporters, so `/tp @e` no longer breaks setups (#139)
- New textures for upgrades and the wrench; the Computer is now a desktop
- Added the Logistics Server, crafted from echo shards, a crafter, crying obsidian, a Computer, netherite ingots and a nether star. It links up to three channels between two networks, in both directions, while its chunk is loaded. A red cross marks linked channels that have nothing to exchange; hover it to see why
- Holding a Computer or Logistics Server shows a white hologram where it will be placed
- Added the Network Upgrade, craftable with either AE2 or Refined Storage parts. Nodes on AE2 and Refined Storage Interfaces now need it to reach the whole storage network; existing nodes without it only see the Interface's own inventory
- Labels can be deleted from the label picker (node editor and clipboard) with the new X button. Deleting a label that nodes still use asks for confirmation and shows how many nodes will be unlabeled
- Logistics Nodes can be worn as a cosmetic helmet; drag one into the helmet slot
- Holding a wrench now shows a node's label under its network name

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed nodes on multiblocks and other late-forming storages not transferring after world load until toggled
- Fixed node culling
- Labels now sync node visibility (visible/hidden) across all nodes sharing the label
- Renamed distribution mode "Round Robin" to "Equal Distribution"
- Channel names now show right after picking a network for a new node, without reopening it (#147)
- An open node screen now picks up new or deleted labels and renamed or recoloured networks from other players
- Fixed nodes not pulling from or pushing into an AE2 ME Interface when the ME network has a storage bus, which logged "A root transaction ... is already active on this thread" (#140)
- Fixed networks failing to save, and filters failing to sync, when a label template or filter contained enchanted items

## Technicals

- Reworked internals to be component heavy
- World data is converted to a new format on first load; back up before updating, worlds opened with 1.13.0 can't go back to 1.12.x
- Updated zh_cn translations
